title: Bed-Hold Charges: Basis, Billing and Due Dates
content:
**Business office manual — Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations charges.**

### Retired clause

The clause under which each booked resident-private entry was charged once at its days times the bed-hold daily rate, rounded half up to the cent, the bed-hold daily rate being the tier's bed-hold percent of the private pay schedule's daily rate in effect on those days for the tier of the room held, whatever payer source covers the resident's stay otherwise, is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current basis below.

### Current basis

Outside the opening entry and the closing entry of a released Private Pay Therapeutic Leave Bed Hold that carries more than one resident-private entry, the resident-private entry of a Private Pay Hospital Leave Bed Hold that carries a single resident-private entry, and the opening entry and the closing entry of a Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed hold that carries more than one resident-private entry, each booked resident-private entry is charged once at its days times the bed-hold daily rate, the tier's bed-hold percent of the private pay schedule's daily rate in effect on those days for the tier of the room held, whatever payer source covers the resident's stay otherwise, rounded half up to the cent; each of those five entries is priced by its own schedule.

### Clauses in force

- Payer-covered reserved days are never billed to the resident, and Medicaid patient pay is unchanged for a month with reserved days.
- Bed-hold charges for a month are billed on the statement day of the following month and are due within the payment due days; they carry no late charge.
- A booked entry is charged once: a booked entry that a charge on the reservation's ledger already names is not charged again.

The tier's bed-hold percent, the statement day, the payment due days and the rounding are the tier's billing terms.

### Illustration of the current basis (hypothetical figures)

A booked resident-private entry of 6 days, outside the five entries named above, on a tier whose bed-hold percent is 100, is charged 6 days times the private pay schedule's daily rate in effect on those days for the tier of the room held, taken at 100 percent — six times that daily rate — rounded half up to the cent.

**Points of judgement.** The rate is that of the tier of the room held, whichever payer covers the resident's stay otherwise. A Medical Assistance resident's patient pay for a month with reserved days stays as it is.

superseded_clauses: Each booked resident_private entry is charged once: the days times the bed-hold daily rate, rounded half up to the cent. The bed-hold daily rate is the tier's bed-hold percent of the private pay schedule's daily rate in effect on those days for the tier of the room held, whatever payer source covers the resident's stay otherwise.
